title: KimpoWorkflow Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for KimpoWorkflow plugin instance

log_level.description: Minimum severity forwarded from the plugin sidecar to the host log center (SDK reserved field).

auto_hop_limit.description: 一次流转里连续自动办理的步骤上限，超过即停下标为事故，防止两个自动节点互相指向形成死循环。
